note: ADDS a 'tiktok' platform ONLY while Browser Use Cloud is the social engine (BROWSER_USE_API_KEY set, no SOCIAL_ENGINE_URL). The self-hosted SocialCrabs engine has no TikTok handler, so with it configured TikTok is not offered. Every supported action is a task template in social/browseruse_engine.js.

search.returns: up to 8 video URLs with author and caption
search.notes: A cloud browser reads the search page; slower and less exact than an API.

view_profile.returns: name, bio, followers, following, likes (as shown)

view_feed.reason: Reading the For You feed through a cloud browser is not wired — it would burn credits for little.

comment.notes: TikTok may hold new comments for review or block them on some videos.

reply.reason: Replying to one specific comment is not wired; she can comment on a video.

connect.reason: Connection requests are a LinkedIn concept.

dm.notes: Replies only: she answers people who already messaged her and never starts a conversation. TikTok also only allows messages between mutual follows or where the person has opened DMs.

read_dms.reason: Not wired — reading an inbox through a cloud browser is unreliable.

post.reason: Uploading a video needs a video file, which a cloud browser task cannot be handed through this layer. Not supported.

engagement.returns: likes/comments counts of the latest videos
